title.zh: Redis 如何在微秒级响应

desc.zh: 一条 SET user:42 "alice" 或 ZRANGEBYSCORE 请求发出去，Redis 的主事件循环几乎在微秒级把结果写回套接字。这篇按 Redis 8.0 的设计与源码规格，把这一趟往返拆开：单线程事件循环与锁竞争、RESP2/RESP3 与管道、redisObject 的 44 字节 embstr 与 listpack、渐进式双表 rehash、带跨度的 ZSET 跳表、Redis 8 多线程网络 I/O、BGSAVE 写时复制与多部分 AOF、采样过期与近似 LRU / Morris 计数器 LFU、16,384 集群槽位与逆二进制 SCAN 游标，以及 Vector Sets 与无共享前沿架构。十一个可动手模型都用页面里重写的同一套算法运行。
desc.en: Send one SET user:42 "alice" or ZRANGEBYSCORE request and Redis's main event loop writes the reply back to the socket in microseconds. Following Redis 8.0 internals and specs, this essay unpacks that round-trip: the lock-free event loop, RESP2/RESP3 and pipelining, redisObject's 44-byte embstr cliff and listpack, progressive two-table rehashing, span-indexed ZSET skiplists, Redis 8 threaded network I/O, BGSAVE fork copy-on-write and multi-part AOF, active expiration and approximate LRU / Morris-counter LFU, 16,384 cluster hash slots and reverse-binary SCAN cursors, plus Vector Sets and shared-nothing frontiers. Eleven hands-on models run the exact underlying algorithms in the page.

title.zh: Redis 单线程事件循环与锁竞争
title.en: Redis single-threaded event loop & lock avoidance

desc.zh: Redis 主循环 aeMain 用 epoll/kqueue 单线程串行执行内存命令，省掉互斥锁和跨核缓存行同步，但任何 O(N) 慢命令都会阻塞整条队列。
desc.en: Redis's aeMain loop multiplexes sockets via epoll/kqueue and runs commands sequentially on one lock-free thread, trading O(N) head-of-line blocking risk for zero mutex overhead.

desc.zh: RESP2/RESP3 用长度前缀在 querybuf 里实现二进制安全零拷贝切片；管道把 N 条命令打包进单次网络 RTT，避开往返空等。
desc.en: RESP2/RESP3 length-prefixed framing enables binary-safe zero-copy slicing inside querybuf, while pipelining amortizes one network RTT across an entire batch.

title.zh: redisObject、44 字节 embstr 与 listpack

desc.zh: 16 字节 redisObject 搭配 3 字节 sdshdr8 让 ≤44 字节字符串一次挤进 64 字节 jemalloc 块（embstr），小集合用只记自身 backlen 的 listpack 消除级联更新。
desc.en: A 16-byte redisObject plus 3-byte sdshdr8 fits strings ≤44 bytes into one 64-byte jemalloc block (embstr), while listpack uses self-length backlen fields to prevent ziplist cascade updates.

title.zh: Redis 字典与渐进式 Rehash

desc.zh: dict 用 SipHash-1-2 哈希键并维护 ht[0]/ht[1] 两张表，借 rehashidx 在每次命令里只搬一个桶，避免全表扩容卡死主循环。
desc.en: Redis's dict uses SipHash-1-2 and dual tables ht[0]/ht[1], advancing rehashidx one bucket per command so multi-million-key resizes never freeze the event loop.

title.zh: ZSET 有序集合与跳跃表（zskiplist）

desc.zh: 大 ZSET 同时维护 O(1) 查分的 dict 和带 span 跨度的 zskiplist（p=1/4，最高 32 层），不用平衡树旋转即可支持范围扫描与精确 ZRANK。
desc.en: Large ZSETs combine a dict for O(1) ZSCORE with a p=1/4, 32-level zskiplist whose forward span counts yield exact O(log N) ZRANK without tree rotations.

zh: redis 跳表为什么不用红黑树

desc.zh: Redis 8 把套接字读写、RESP 解析和 TLS 加解密并行卸载给 io-threads 工作线程，仅保留单核无锁顺序执行命令。
desc.en: Redis 8 offloads socket reads, RESP parsing, TLS, and reply writes to io-threads workers while preserving lock-free single-threaded command execution.

zh: redis 是单线程还是多线程

title.zh: BGSAVE 写时复制与多部分 AOF 持久化

desc.zh: BGSAVE 用 fork() 共享 4 KiB 只读页直到主线程写入触发写时复制，分散写入会把内存推向两倍；Multi-Part AOF 拆出 base/incr/manifest 减少重写卡顿。
desc.en: BGSAVE uses fork() to share 4 KiB pages via Copy-on-Write until writes duplicate dirty pages toward 2× RAM, while Multi-Part AOF splits base/incr/manifest logs.

title.zh: Redis 惰性删除与定期采样过期（activeExpireCycle）

desc.zh: Redis 结合读时惰性清理与 activeExpireCycle 每轮随机抽 20 个 TTL 键，默认以 10% 残留过期比例和 effort 预算截断循环，防止清理卡死主循环。
desc.en: Redis pairs lazy read-time expiration with activeExpireCycle sampling 20 TTL keys per loop, halting once stale samples drop below 10% (tuned by active-expire-effort).

title.zh: 近似 LRU 采样池与 8 位 Morris 计数器 LFU

desc.zh: Redis 省掉每键 16 字节链表指针，仅凭 24 位 lru 字段和 maxmemory-samples=5 采样池逼近真 LRU，并拆出 8 位概率 Morris 计数器追踪百万级 LFU 热度。
desc.en: Redis avoids 16 B/key list pointers by sampling maxmemory-samples=5 keys into a 16-slot pool for LRU, or splitting robj.lru into a 16-bit minute clock and 8-bit Morris LFU counter.

desc.zh: 集群用 CRC16(key) mod 16384 分片，并用 {tag} 把多键锁定在同一节点；错误路由依槽位是否迁移返回 -MOVED 或临时 -ASK。
desc.en: Cluster shards across 16,384 slots via CRC16(key) & 16383, pins multi-key groups using {tag}, and answers misrouted calls with permanent -MOVED or transient -ASK redirects.

zh: redis 集群为什么是 16384 个槽

title.zh: SCAN 逆二进制游标与扩缩容遍历

desc.zh: KEYS * 会阻塞主线程；SCAN 通过位反转递增（从最高位向低位步进），在哈希表翻倍或缩容时仍保证一轮扫描不漏键。
desc.en: KEYS * stalls the single thread; SCAN reverses bits to increment from MSB down so table doubling or shrinking mid-iteration never misses keys.

title.zh: Redis 8 Vector Sets、kvobj 与无共享架构
title.en: Redis 8 Vector Sets, kvobj & shared-nothing engines

desc.zh: Redis 8 引入内置 HNSW 与默认 Q8 8 位量化的 Vector Sets（VADD/VSIM）和 8.2 kvobj；社区与竞品则在 Valkey 9 per-slot 字典及 Dragonfly 无共享多核架构上分路演进。
desc.en: Redis 8 adds HNSW-backed Vector Sets (VADD/VSIM, Q8 8-bit quantization) and 8.2 kvobj, while Valkey 9 advances per-slot dicts and Dragonfly pursues shared-nothing multi-core sharding.
